{"consolidated_memory":"storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql lock timeout issues - TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS:

INCIDENT 1 [2026-02-18]:
- File: storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql
- Problem: lock timeout in migration 0042
- Trigger: appeared after rolling restart of the fleet
- Signal: lock wait tripping statement timeout
- Root cause: cache entry never invalidated on write
- Fix: invalidated the cache entry inside the write transaction
- PR #3799 on branch fix/lock-timeout-1
- Repro: run migration against a loaded table
- Result: nightly rollup matched source counts for 22 days running

INCIDENT 2 [2026-05-23]:
- File: storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql
- Problem: lock timeout in migration 0042
- Trigger: appeared only for payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Signal: lock wait tripping statement timeout
- Root cause: clock skew between the two hosts
- Fix: switched deadline to monotonic clock
- PR #8513 on branch fix/lock-timeout-2
- Repro: run migration against a loaded table
- Result: cold start dropped 75 percent to 125 ms

Both incidents worked on same file/corner; context carried over from earlier lock timeout work. Same signal (lock wait timeout) but distinct root causes, fixes, and measured outcomes."}
